verdict.rationale: Linear's changelog documents a first-party 'Write with Agent' action. It reviews changes made since the last update, checks the linked Slack channel, and writes an update draft for the user to refine, which delivers AI-drafted status updates from recent activity. Shared skills for 'drafting updates' reinforce this. Missing for 10: explicit confirmation that it covers both project and initiative updates, in-depth docs beyond a changelog blurb, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can have AI draft a project or initiative status update from recent activity

citations.quote: The agent reviews changes made since the last update, checks messages in the linked Slack channel, and writes an update draft for you to refine.
click Write with Agent to let Linear do it for you.
Sharing a skill helps your team standardize recurring workflows like writing specs, running weekly planning, or drafting updates.
